test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per the 2011 census, which of the following states had the least percentage of Indian population in it?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The least populated state in the country is Sikkim with a population of **60,7688.04.**
 
• The biggest city in Sikkim is Gangtok which is the capital city of the state.
 
• Sikkim imparts its lines to China in the north and upper east, Bhutan in the **east, Nepal in the west, and West Bengal in the south.**
 
• Sikkim has a populace of** 6.11 Lakhs,** an increment from the figure of **5.41 Lakh in 2011 statistics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The state with the most minimal populace thickness is **Arunachal Pradesh** and the Association Domain with the least thickness of populace is Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• The absolute population of Mizoram according to the 2011 evaluation is **1,097,206 **of which males and females are** 555,339 and 541,867 **separately.
 
• According to subtleties from Statistics 2011**, Manipur** has a populace of **28.56 Lakhs,** an increment from a figure of **22.94 Lakh** in the 2001 census.
 
• According to subtleties from Statistics 2011, **Meghalaya **has a populace of **29.67 Lakhs,** an increment from the figure of **23.19 Lakh **in the 2001 census.​
